title: Complete consumers and terminal semantics for the single communication module
statement: The communication block is exercised end to end against the real service after main's terminal fence: facts, payloads, fresh native admission, temporary detach and terminal close all behave as specified, and the channel coexists with the original journal paging/chunk transport. Product Work recovery, the full Broker chain, SIGKILL and native/installed facts remain NOT_REACHED and are not claimed by module green.

corrections: wave-31 reported that shutdown leaves a pending fact unknown; that observation came from a shutdown frame without an id (protocol error, never executed). With a valid frame id and main's terminal fence, the pending fact is closed and a pending native intent is indeterminate.

wave-31's reported B gap (closeAdmission only dropping stdio/sink ids) is superseded at the observed main source by finish() calling attach.close(); the service still drops only the two adapter ids on admission close, but terminal finish now closes every lease.
